findings.statement: Parity of selected descriptor-summary vertices is insufficient for the scalar dependency residue on all three hard carriers.
Parity of unordered descriptor-summary pairs induced by OOO motif triples is insufficient on all three hard carriers.
Combining vertex and pair boundary parities remains insufficient on all three hard carriers; the failures cannot be repaired by their direct sum.
Within the frozen EW-RS-067 vertex identity and linear GF(2) boundary ladder, complete triple-motif identity is load-bearing for the observed scalar correction.

The result supports a genuinely three-way scalar interaction relative to the selected motif representation and tested linear boundary operators, but does not establish an intrinsic universal three-body law for Connect Four.

nonclaims: Failure of ordinary vertex/pair boundaries does not exclude other mechanically defined circuit, exchange, orientation, or nonlinear structural laws on triple motifs.
Triple-motif one-hot coefficients are not promoted as invariant syndrome coefficients.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
No Q-A/Q-F, universal cubic sufficiency, standard-7x6 qualification, or center-opening proof follows.
next_question: What mechanically generated circuit/exchange/orientation invariant of the selected OOO triple motifs can compress the triple-motif scalar map without outcome-selecting individual triples?
